中文施测措辞已于 2026-07-26 冻结（v5.1 Final wording）：19 条量表条目逐条对照官方原文完成语义等价审计（GPT 正向翻译 → GPT 网页端对照复核 → 仓库助手独立审计，三次独立通过；微调 AQ-IQ2 去"能够"、AQ-EQ2 去"看起来被"）。预实验认知访谈改为确认性检查（最高优先 TIA_RC1/RC4、Q2 与 AQ-IQ3 判别），发现理解不良才按修订—重测—再冻结处理。
预实验冻结项：遮挡时长（0.6–0.9 s 内取定，避开 0.45/1.0 s 边界）、Q10 是否启用、AQ 缩减规则是否触发（单区块 >150 s 或连续同分 ≥5 项 → 停用 AQ_EQ3/AQ_IQ1）、方法级问卷模态。

在静止观察阶段，虚拟内容保持在同一位置不动。
During static observation, the virtual content stayed in the same position without moving.
时间稳定性；pilot 检查“同一位置”参照系理解
在拿起、移动和旋转物体时，虚拟内容始终附着在真实物体上的同一位置。
While I picked up, moved, and rotated the object, the virtual content remained attached to the same location on the physical object.

While I rotated the object, the orientation of the virtual content stayed consistent with the orientation of the physical object.
把物体放到桌面后，虚拟内容很快就稳定下来。
After I placed the object on the table, the virtual content settled quickly.
默认停用；预实验冻结是否启用
虚拟内容实时响应我对真实物体的操作。
The virtual object responds in real-time.
The virtual content responds in real-time to my manipulation of the physical object.
AQ-IQ 子量表分 = IQ1/IQ2/IQ3 均值（分析派生）
在交互过程中，虚拟内容随真实物体平滑运动。
The virtual content moves smoothly with the physical object during interaction.
遮挡移除后，虚拟内容恢复到了与真实物体一致的位置。
After the occlusion was removed, the virtual content recovered to a position consistent with the physical object.
虚拟内容出现的位置，与真实物体实际所在的位置相符。
The virtual content appeared at a position that matched where the physical object actually was.

虚拟内容与真实物体及周围真实元素自然融合。
The virtual object blends in with real elements.
The virtual content blends in with the physical object and surrounding real elements.
AQ-EQ 子量表分 = EQ1/EQ2/EQ3 均值（分析派生）
虚拟内容真实地嵌入在真实物体及其现实环境中。
The virtual object is realistically embedded in the environment.
The virtual content is realistically embedded in the physical object and its real-world context.
接管原 Q4 合理可信构念
虚拟内容的尺度与真实物体及现实世界中的事物相匹配。
The size of the virtual object is in scale to things in the real world.
The size of the virtual content is in scale to the physical object and things in the real world.
预期天花板；保留以维持完整子量表
通过操作真实物体与虚拟内容进行交互是直观的。
Interaction with the virtual object is intuitive.
Interaction with the virtual content through manipulation of the physical object is intuitive.
在需要虚拟内容准确附着于真实物体的混合现实应用中，我愿意依赖这种锚定方法。
I would be willing to rely on this anchoring method in an MR application that requires virtual content to be accurately attached to a physical object.

总体而言，该方法在锚点稳定性与响应及时性之间取得了合适的平衡。
Overall, this method achieved an appropriate balance between anchor stability and responsiveness.
